aliases: expedited community redevelopment plan tax increment financing project
summary: Common shorthand for Nebraska expedited review of eligible one-project redevelopment plans under sec. 18-2155, with possible financing through the sec. 18-2147 division-of-taxes mechanism.
plain_language: Micro-TIF is a smaller, faster TIF path, but it is still tied to redevelopment law, city/CRA approval, assessor valuation work, and TIF tax allocation if Question 6 is yes.

facts.object: expedited review pathway, not a separate tax exemption
expedited review of redevelopment plans under Neb. Rev. Stat. sec. 18-2155
Question 6 determines whether the project will use division of taxes under sec. 18-2147 in whole or in part.
Cities/CRAs may add local supplemental forms, maps, deadlines, pre-application steps, and staff review details.

relationships.note: Small expedited review path within Nebraska TIF domain.

source_refs.citation: City of Hastings, What is Micro-TIF? packet.
